head: 04aea6ddced70c9b645f130e4c9382d9f79dff83

commits.subject: gx: a home's fill flag is stored with release and read with acquire, as stage 4's pool reads it outside the GPU mutex
commits.decision: Release/acquire fixes BBHOST Home::filled publication to its extra pool. There is no Home::filled equivalent in the native tree; inspect actual native publication owners rather than copying an unrelated atomic flag.

commits.subject: gx: where the homes' default holds, Windows' run commit gives way to them, and a card with 6 GiB of video memory free takes them with the pool's budget
commits.decision: Windows run-commit give-way and >=6 GiB free small-VRAM homes are gated above 60 FPS. This fixed-60 Linux profile does not meet that rate condition.

commits.subject: windows: the build links SPIRV-Tools' optimizer, so the tables a no-fallback variant never reads stay out of GX's ring as on Linux
commits.decision: Windows SPIRV-Tools optimizer linking fix. Current native Linux build already links its shader tooling; no Windows package is part of this PC qualification.

commits.subject: gxvk lists: a segment the walk meets past its first draw gives its draws back to their own splices
commits.decision: Partial segment fallback gives draws back to original splices in BBHOST list execution; local ordered draw assistant uses published/consumed cursors and a recording gate.

commits.subject: gxvk lists: the pool's publications of targets and views keep two runs and two views a slot
commits.decision: Two-run/two-view publication protects BBHOST pool target/view identity. Native image memo and timeline lifetime differ; do not reproduce only the cache shape.

commits.subject: gxvk lists: the pool rests while a frame cap holds the frame
commits.decision: The added pool parks/rests while the cap has slack. Native 60 profile already sets GPU/PIPE spin to zero and parks its existing workers; the BBHOST extra pool is not present. No new pool is justified by this 60 FPS target.

commits.subject: gxvk lists: the pool's commits lose their locks and locked adds
commits.decision: Lock/add removal is in the BBHOST GX list pool, absent in the local packet recording architecture. Requires semantic comparison, not direct cherry-pick.

commits.subject: gxvk lists: a diagnostic of when each draw was stored, committed and met by the command processor (BBHOST_GXVK_LISTS_TIMES=1)
commits.decision: Draw-store/commit/meet timing belongs to BBHOST GX list execution; local ordered-transfer capture and frame/timeline instrumentation exist. Port only if measuring equivalent native work.

limitations: Upstream performance and ThreadSanitizer figures are their reports, not local measurements.
This review does not certify all renderer behavior or close the full integration goal.
